skills.name: veyrul-media-knowledge
skills.description: Find saved media workflows, reusable code and source-qualified references before choosing a production technique or diagnosing a media failure.
examplePrompts: Find a documented Blender workflow for quilted padding before editing the mesh.
Find saved FFmpeg guidance for retiming captions after cutting video clips.
Find source-qualified references for a media workflow under my tool and hardware constraints.

recovery.on: The public service is unavailable, rate limited or has no applicable evidence
recovery.next: Continue with the host documentation and ordinary tools; do not repeat the same request.

recovery.on: The optional lookup package is no longer needed
recovery.next: There is no scene edit to undo; remove the package with the supported marketplace uninstall command.
